Container.Name: twonote
Container.Overview: TwoNote sync server. Stores only end-to-end encrypted notes (ciphertext) for the TwoNote apps. One account per server; registration closes after the first account is created. Plain HTTP on port 8080, intended for LAN or VPN use.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: HTTP port the TwoNote apps connect to.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (twonote.db). Everything in it is ciphertext; back up this folder.
